payload.summary: The account msmith experienced 10 failed login attempts from the source IP 10.77.0.64, followed by a successful login. This source IP is known to the account and has been used successfully in the past. There is no documented change that explains this activity, suggesting a potential brute force attack.

attack_chain.description: The attacker used brute force techniques to guess the password of the account msmith from the source IP 10.77.0.64.

risk_factors: Multiple failed login attempts followed by a successful login
No documented change explains the activity
The source IP is known but has been used for brute force attempts

proposed_actions.justification: The account msmith experienced multiple failed login attempts followed by a successful login, indicating a potential brute force attack. Disabling the account will prevent further unauthorized access.
